description: Liquidations that HAPPENED: totals of the last hours (long/short USD, per venue, top coins, largest single liquidation) plus the latest individual liquidations the data licence allows, optionally only large ones (min_usd) or one side. Use it for "how much got liquidated today?" or "latest big liquidations". Counts as two API requests (totals and the latest list).

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

hours.description: Window in hours (default 24; capped by the plan history: no key 24 h, a free key 30 days; the answer says when it was cut).

limit.description: Number of latest liquidations (default 5, at most 50).

min_usd.description: Only liquidations of at least this many USD in the latest list.

side.description: Only liquidated longs or shorts in the latest list.

venue.description: Only this venue for the latest liquidations list.

name: get_liquidations

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

latest.description: Latest single liquidations: ts, venue, coin, side, price, usd.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

summary.description: hours, totalUsd, longUsd, shortUsd, count, byVenue, topCoins, largest, coveredSince.

title: Liquidations
